info.title: MarketBox 2.0 Open API
info.description: The MarketBox public API. Use this API to manage bookings, orders, service offerings, and providers across your MarketBox projects. All endpoints are versioned under `/v1` and authenticated with an API key in the `x-api-key` header.

ApiKeyAuth.name: x-api-key
ApiKeyAuth.description: API key minted in the MarketBox dashboard. Scope is restricted to the projects you select at creation time.
